export_pytorch_to_caffe2: export a PyTorch model to ONNX and convert it to a Caffe2 prepared net
create_vocab_index: create a Caffe2 string index from a vocabulary list and freeze it for inference
numericalize_string_features: add numericalization operators to a Caffe2 predict net to convert string features to IDs
export_predictor_file: export Caffe2 init and predict nets to a Caffe2 predictor minidb file
convert_blob_name: convert a Caffe2 blob name by appending the string value suffix for predictor features
